analysisLimits: These are nine policy compatibility replays, not nine independent or model-assisted conversations.
No private asset can be obtained in the frozen simulator by construction. Zero successes are not a security-efficacy finding.
Natural-language request content is only an annotation; identifiers and relationship checks have no modeled semantics.
Strict missing-prerequisite stopping was applied; no substitute identifiers or additional probe actions were invented.
Objective success is unobserved; policy-effectiveness comparison is inconclusive because all scenarios stop before adaptive divergence.
Task metrics exclude the operator stop action; full metrics retain it.
No blinded objective inference, actor confidence, or decoy recognition was assessed.
